pages.text: An arcane focus (gold fittings set with amethyst) on a wrapped shaft makes a staff, or on a wand core a wand. Use one to choose the spell it casts; it gives that spell's school spell power, a staff more than a wand, by its $(#d4a017)★$().

pages.title: Grips
pages.text: Craft straps with a forged sword or axe to fit a strapped grip: the weapon keeps its $(#d4a017)★$(), wear and enchantments, and swings a little faster for the straps' $(#d4a017)★$(). One grip per weapon.
